primary_findings.quote: For the primary outcome of any fracture, little to no effect was found from use of calcium supplements (11 trials, 9067 participants; risk ratio 0.91, 95% confidence interval 0.81 to 1.01; moderate certainty)
For the primary outcome of any fracture, little to no effect was found from use of vitamin D supplements (36 trials, 92 045 participants; 1.00, 0.95 to 1.06; high certainty)
For the primary outcome of any fracture, little to no effect was found from use of combined supplementation (15 trials, 51 126 participants; 0.91, 0.84 to 0.99; high certainty)
